acceptance_scope: Three actually viewed native Blender renders and closure of the specific source-visible appearance/structural corrections raised in v2, v3 and v5. This is not global manifold, browser, runtime, survey or photogrammetric acceptance.

images.observation: Both open internal courts and outward north/south notches preserved. The last short black strip at the central platform rear/south-court corner is no longer visible; side and rear return now look continuous in this image.
Whole connected compound, four modern corner blocks, both projecting historic east ends with axial upper window and arched door. Earlier dark through-height end corners have disappeared.

Narrow two-tier gold roof above broad stone platform, three tall main windows, upper three red arches, octagonal apertures, balcony and outer entrance lattice remain. Previous front platform black vertical seams have disappeared.

limits: Geometry is a photograph-informed procedural reconstruction, not a measured survey or a promise that every facade is photorealistic.
Rear/courtyard bay counts, hidden doors/equipment, local dimensions and decorative patterns include inference; the four licensed photos do not document all sides.

M101 lists 18.49m eaves, not ridge maximum. Model tier assignment and approximately22.48m highest decoration are modeling interpretations, not directly measured source dimensions. The expansion10.8m table versus11.05m plan-H discrepancy remains documented.
Materials are procedural colors with no photographic stone/glass textures; weathering and exact painted motif strokes are simplified.
Exterior geometric entrance lattice is not claimed as the historic interior peacock gate. Interior rooms and peacock gates are outside this exterior model scope.

The known main arch surround -0.28m defect was corrected in earlier revisions. Final report overall bound retains approximately-0.02m for another trim; this visual review does not assert all geometry is nonnegative or certify triangle-level closure.
These three native views do not demonstrate web/LOD equivalence, runtime owner replacement, interaction, performance, or automatic weak-network retry. Separate project QA covers such claims.
